bug_semantics: Conversion Sunburst/Treemap tooltips feed attacker-controlled slice names and counts into ECharts function formatters as raw HTML. Names originate from STIX/MISP conversion payloads (STIX types, relationship_type, indicator pattern prefixes, MISP category/type). ECharts treats formatter return values as HTML, so a crafted name or value injects markup or script-capable content that executes when another user views the chart and hovers the slice.

reasoning: CVE-2026-73156 is a published CIRCL record (not rejected/withdrawn); GHSA-fq55-48v3-mc95 has withdrawn_at=null. The flaw is CWE-79 in ECharts tooltip formatters: ConvertSunburst/ConversionSunburst interpolates STIX/MISP-derived slice names and counts into HTML that ECharts renders on hover. The smallest first-write of that mechanism is a584a9da2a2f6540b240470347666b70494f1aad, which added website/web/static/js/graph/convertSunburst.js with both unescaped tooltip formatters. Immediate parent f09f10ab6378ad8d8fab3de1590f51f27f28ab32 is a real commit whose tree lacks the file and the `${p.name}` interpolation, so introducer_parent_absent=false. 3b52147 later inlined the sunburst formatter (blame on the pre-fix one-liner) and 77237433 renamed the path; both are excluded as BIC under the move/refactor rule. Advisory-linked c5b024a8ef5632f8939cfe2dad9026064698f4bb is the direct fix (escapeHtml wrappers) and is used for both fix_sha and direct_fix_sha; it sits after v1.4 and in v1.5, matching affected <=1.4.0. AI attribution is taken only from the BIC commit object: human author/committer ecrou-exact , empty trailers, no bot identity, therefore NOT_AI. Same-repo prior AI hits on other commits were not used to invert BIC search.
